geometry_scope: Fixed nominal dimensions, chosen from the declared generation ranges. Per-scene sizes, poses, table height and state are not estimator inputs. Fixture is assumed horizontal; capsule axis is estimated in 3D.
fusion: For each synchronized sample and target, prefer accepted wrist estimate, otherwise accepted top estimate; no truth-based selection or averaging.
uncertainty_scope: Deterministic quality gates, not calibrated probabilities or certified bounds. Report missed estimates and accepted bad estimates.
selection_policy: Freeze before validation pose results. Any later threshold or algorithm revision must receive a new protocol id and be reported as development tuning. Reserved test predictions are prohibited in this entry point.
